description: AMS synchronization, mixed-filament metadata preservation, and vendor-specific HRC lookup.

mutants.description: A non-BBL vendor must not contribute a required HRC value.
Known BBL filament types retain their configured HRC requirement.
Known HRC lookup results must be returned instead of always using the unknown default.
A matching Generic PA-CF preset must beat the shorter Generic PA fallback.
Placeholder trays beyond the existing project slots still receive aligned fallback slots.
Mixed filament component metadata survives physical AMS synchronization.
Color-only synchronization falls back to tray order when no supplied map entry matches.
Identical unmapped trays are deduplicated while appending.
Two project slots mapped to one physical tray must be reported as a merge.
